enclosure.title: SECC Steel Enclosure
enclosure.description: Grounded 0.8 mm electro-galvanized steel casing providing electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding and structural rigidity.

cooling_fan.title: 120mm Temperature-Controlled Fan
cooling_fan.description: Thermally regulated fluid-dynamic bearing exhaust fan maintaining internal component temperatures with silent low-RPM operation.

intake_grill.title: Honeycomb Intake Fan Grill
intake_grill.description: Stamped hexagonal mesh guard maximizing airflow intake area while preventing foreign object intrusion and user contact.

ac_inlet_switch.title: AC Inlet & Rocker Power Switch
ac_inlet_switch.description: Standard IEC C14 3-pin appliance inlet receptacle with integrated master power disconnect rocker switch and line EMI filter.

modular_panel.title: Modular Cable Output Panel
modular_panel.description: Detachable wiring receptacle matrix routing regulated +12V, +5V, and +3.3V power rails to motherboards, GPUs, and peripherals.

main_transformer.title: High-Frequency Main Transformer
main_transformer.description: Ferrite E-core power transformer providing galvanic safety isolation while stepping down high-voltage rectified DC to secondary rails.

pfc_inductor_caps.title: Active PFC Choke & Bulk Capacitor
pfc_inductor_caps.description: Toroidal power factor correction (PFC) inductor and 450V electrolytic reservoir capacitor stabilizing rectified mains voltage.

main_pcb.title: Heavy-Copper Main PCB
main_pcb.description: Multi-layer FR4 circuit board with 2oz copper power planes minimizing electrical resistance and thermal losses during high loads.

dc_dc_daughterboards.title: DC-DC Synchronous Step-Down Modules
dc_dc_daughterboards.description: Dedicated vertical daughterboards converting the main +12V rail into tightly regulated +5V and +3.3V secondary outputs.

protection_supervision.title: Protection & Supervisor Circuitry
protection_supervision.description: Hardware monitoring circuit providing Over-Current (OCP), Over-Voltage (OVP), Under-Voltage (UVP), and Short-Circuit Protection (SCP).

secondary_caps_chokes.title: Solid Polymer Capacitors & Chokes
secondary_caps_chokes.description: High-end solid conductive polymer output filtering capacitors smoothing voltage ripple and transient response spikes.

rating_plate.title: Electrical Specification Plate
rating_plate.description: Comprehensive specification label detailing continuous wattage ratings, rail amperage limits, efficiency tier, and safety certifications.
